051/**
052 * Provides methods to load a constraint set expressed in any supported
053 * Metaschema format.
054 * <p>
055 * Loaded constraint instances are cached to avoid the need to load them for
056 * every use. Any constraint set imported is also loaded and cached
057 * automatically.
058 */
059public class BindingConstraintLoader
060    extends AbstractLoader<List<IConstraintSet>>
061    implements IConstraintLoader {
062
063  @NonNull
064  private final IBoundLoader loader;
065
066  /**
067   * Construct a new loader.
068   *
069   * @param bindingContext
070   *          the Metaschema binding information used to parse constraint data
071   */
072  public BindingConstraintLoader(@NonNull IBindingContext bindingContext) {
073    this.loader = bindingContext.newBoundLoader();
074    // this.loader.enableFeature(DeserializationFeature.DESERIALIZE_VALIDATE_CONSTRAINTS);
075  }
076
077  @Override
078  protected List<IConstraintSet> parseResource(@NonNull URI resource, @NonNull Deque<URI> visitedResources)
079      throws IOException {
080    StaticContext.Builder builder = StaticContext.builder()
081        .baseUri(resource);
082    builder.useWildcardWhenNamespaceNotDefaulted(true);
083
084    // parse this set of constraints
085    Object constraintsDocument = loader.load(resource);
086
087    List<IConstraintSet> retval;
088    if (constraintsDocument instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints) {
089      MetaschemaModuleConstraints obj = (MetaschemaModuleConstraints) constraintsDocument;
090
091      // now check if this constraint set imports other constraint sets
092      List<MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Import> imports = CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getImports());
093
094      // handle imports
095      @NonNull
096      Set<IConstraintSet> importedConstraints;
097      if (imports.isEmpty()) {
098        importedConstraints = CollectionUtil.emptySet();
099      } else {
100        try {
101          importedConstraints = new LinkedHashSet<>();
102          for (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Import imported : imports) {
103            URI importedResource = imported.getHref();
104            importedResource = ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.resolve(importedResource));
105            importedConstraints.addAll(loadInternal(importedResource, visitedResources));
106          }
107        } catch (MetaschemaException ex) {
108          throw new IOException(ex);
109        }
110      }
111
112      // handle namespace to prefix bindings
113      CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getNamespaceBindings()).stream()
114          .forEach(binding -> builder.namespace(
115              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getPrefix()),
116              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getUri())));
117      ISource source = ISource.externalSource(builder.build(), false);
118
119      // create the constraint set
120      retval = CollectionUtil.singletonList(new ScopedConstraintSet(
121          source,
122          parseScopedConstraints(obj, source),
123          new LinkedHashSet<>(importedConstraints)));
124    } else if (constraintsDocument instanceof MetaschemaMetaConstraints) {
125      MetaschemaMetaConstraints obj = (MetaschemaMetaConstraints) constraintsDocument;
126
127      // now check if this constraint set imports other constraint sets
128      List<MetaschemaMetaConstraints.Import> imports = CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getImports());
129
130      List<IConstraintSet> importedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
131      if (!imports.isEmpty()) {
132        try {
133          for (MetaschemaMetaConstraints.Import imported : imports) {
134            URI importedResource = imported.getHref();
135            importedResource = ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.resolve(importedResource));
136            importedConstraints.addAll(loadInternal(importedResource, visitedResources));
137          }
138        } catch (MetaschemaException ex) {
139          throw new IOException(ex);
140        }
141      }
142
143      CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getNamespaceBindings()).stream()
144          .forEach(binding -> builder.namespace(
145              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getPrefix()),
146              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getUri())));
147
148      ISource source = ISource.externalSource(builder.build(), false);
149
150      List<MetaConstraintSet.Context> contexts
151          = ObjectUtils.notNull(CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getContexts()).stream()
152              .map(context -> parseContext(ObjectUtils.notNull(context), null, source))
153              .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList()));
154      retval = Collections.singletonList(new MetaConstraintSet(source, importedConstraints, contexts));
155    } else {
156      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(String.format("Unsupported constraint content '%s'.", resource));
157    }
158    return retval;
159  }
160
161  /**
162   * Parse individual constraint definitions from the provided bound constraint
163   * document.
164   *
165   * @param obj
166   *          the bound constraint document
167   * @param source
168   *          the source of the constraint content
169   * @return the scoped constraint definitions
170   */
171  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidInstantiatingObjectsInLoops") // intentional
172  @NonNull
173  protected List<IScopedContraints> parseScopedConstraints(
174      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints obj,
175      @NonNull ISource source) {
176    List<IScopedContraints> scopedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
177
178    for (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope scope : CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getScopes())) {
179      assert scope != null;
180
181      List<ITargetedConstraints> targetedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
182      for (IValueConstraintsBase constraintsObj : CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(scope.getConstraints())) {
183        if (constraintsObj instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Assembly) {
184          targetedConstraints.add(handleScopedAssembly(
185              (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Assembly) constraintsObj,
186              source));
187        } else if (constraintsObj instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Field) {
188          targetedConstraints.add(handleScopedField(
189              (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Field) constraintsObj,
190              source));
191        } else if (constraintsObj instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Flag) {
192          targetedConstraints.add(handleScopedFlag(
193              (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Flag) constraintsObj,
194              source));
195        }
196      }
197
198      URI namespace = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(scope.getMetaschemaNamespace());
199      String shortName = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(scope.getMetaschemaShortName());
200
201      scopedConstraints.add(new DefaultScopedContraints(
202          namespace,
203          shortName,
204          CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(targetedConstraints)));
205    }
206    return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(scopedConstraints);
207  }
208
209  private static AssemblyTargetedConstraints handleScopedAssembly(
210      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Assembly obj,
211      @NonNull ISource source) {
212    IModelConstrained constraints = new AssemblyConstraintSet(source);
213    ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, obj, source);
214    return new AssemblyTargetedConstraints(
215        source,
216        () -> Collections.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
217            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(obj.getTarget()),
218            source.getStaticContext())),
219        constraints);
220  }
221
222  private static FieldTargetedConstraints handleScopedField(
223      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Field obj,
224      @NonNull ISource source) {
225    IValueConstrained constraints = new ValueConstraintSet(source);
226    ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, obj, source);
227
228    return new FieldTargetedConstraints(
229        source,
230        () -> Collections.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
231            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(obj.getTarget()),
232            source.getStaticContext())),
233        constraints);
234  }
235
236  private static FlagTargetedConstraints handleScopedFlag(
237      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Flag obj,
238      @NonNull ISource source) {
239    IValueConstrained constraints = new ValueConstraintSet(source);
240    ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, obj, source);
241
242    return new FlagTargetedConstraints(
243        source,
244        () -> Collections.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
245            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(obj.getTarget()),
246            source.getStaticContext())),
247        constraints);
248  }
249
250  private MetaConstraintSet.Context parseContext(
251      @NonNull MetapathContext contextObj,
252      @Nullable MetaConstraintSet.Context parent,
253      @NonNull ISource source) {
254
255    // generate the metapaths
256    List<IMetapathExpression> metapaths = ObjectUtils
257        .notNull(CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(contextObj.getMetapaths()).stream()
258            .map(MetaschemaMetapath::getTarget)
259            .map(metapath -> IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
260                ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(metapath),
261                source.getStaticContext())))
262        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
263
264    // parse the constraints
265    AssemblyConstraints contextConstraints = contextObj.getConstraints();
266    IModelConstrained constraints = new AssemblyConstraintSet(source);
267    if (contextConstraints != null) {
268      ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, contextConstraints, source);
269    }
270
271    // create the context
272    MetaConstraintSet.Context context = new MetaConstraintSet.Context(parent, source, metapaths, constraints);
273
274    // create the child contexts
275    List<MetaConstraintSet.Context> childContexts
276        = ObjectUtils.notNull(CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(contextObj.getContexts()).stream()
277            .map(childObj -> parseContext(ObjectUtils.notNull(childObj), context, source))
278            .collect(Collectors.toList()));
279
280    context.addAll(childContexts);
281
282    return context;
283  }
284}
